comment: Every class was very entertaining. Grades based around exams, participation, reading quizzes, and journals. Can be annoying cause exam grade is subjective to an extent, but do the readings and you'll be fine. Very engaging teacher that made classes enjoyable and unique. He's like a caricature of an English teacher but in a good way. Cool guy.
Excellent Professor, participation matters a ton. Cares about his students a lot.

One of my all time favorite classes. Dr. Pelletier is amazing. One of the most challenging classes I have taken at UR, (IK it is a FYS but I am not an English person, ok). It it is challenging because he pushes students to achieve their full potential. You would be hard pressed to find a more compelling lecturer and skilled discussion leader.

The type of professor who will make you consider majoring in English. Can't recommend enough for gen eds he can be a tough grader but is very clear about what he is looking for and gives lengthly feedback to help you improve.

Dr. Pelletier is an AWESOME teacher. Super smart and funny, lectures are interesting and engaging. Be ready to read a lot and participation in class is 1/4 of your grade. I would totally recommend him but be prepared for a pretty decent amount of work and tough grading on papers.

Pelletier was fantastic. His class was my favorite and the readings were interesting. He was a somewhat harsh grader on papers but if you meet with him ahead the due date he'll tell you what he wants you to fix.

Dr. Pelletier clearly knows his stuff when it comes to writing and literature. He's also quite funny and entertaining. However, he grades meticulously when it comes to writing and is almost hard to please. This is definitely one of the more difficult FYSs, and Dr. Pelletier admits to that. I would recommend but only if you're already a good writer.

I HIGHLY recommend this course. Dr. Pelletier is an amazing professor who truly cares about his students and is very reachable outside class.Participation is a large chunk of your grade, but class lectures are very engaging. He's clear with expectations and grades fairly hard, but there are only two papers that he gives plenty of time to work on.
Clearly passionate about the subject. Very strict grading standards, but overall an interesting class

Dr. Pelletier gets me hyped for about anything he enjoys. He is a brilliant guy, and literature and comedy is an awesome class. You have to show up every class and participate but he guides his discussions really well. Also the reading load is surpringsly light for an English class

Pelletier is such an amazing person-loved every minute of his lectures he's hilarious and so wise-- He just wants you to participate and think so be ready to discuss -- Paper topics can be difficult, he grades them harsh but fair, there are only two essays so make sure to go to him for help- He also assigns less reading compared to other engl prof

One of the brightest people you will ever meet. Such a pleasure to listen to him analyze and seamlessly bring students into the discussion based class. assigns very reasonable nightly readings. He will tear your paper apart, but all his feedback (which is a LOT) is incredibly insightful. Take Literature & Comedy. Loved every single class period.
Take any class with Pelletier. Incredible guy. He made showing up to class very fun. I'm not an English major, and I still loved it.

Really interesting guy to listen to and have an engaging lecture/conversation. His essays are difficult in the sense that you will never figure out how he wants you to write. The final is not difficult and participation counts for 25% of the grade.

I took 3 classes with KP and he was the reason I settled on English as my major. He sets clear expectations in his syllabus and doesn't back down on them, which I respect. He's incredibly knowledgeable about American literature and it makes you want to learn it all too. One of the few professors I tried to stay in touch with.

god this guy is insanely smart. There are many thoughtful class discussions that he obviously spent a lot of time preparing. All around a really solid professor too because he made me feel like I was valuable as a student. Take him if you really want to improve as a writer/critical thinker and are going to put in effort each day

I had him for 3 English classes & loved every one. He's a tough grader but is more than willing to help you do well/prepare. He truly knows his stuff, can relate to students, and somehow brings to life books that otherwise would put me to sleep. He made me love English again. MUST TAKE. Ps hes also super witty/funny & will call u out if u r a jerk
Impossible and oddly hard to read (you feel like he likes you, but then he doesn't). Prone to overanalysis, fitting the stereotype of useless English academics. Do not take.

Wow just excellent teacher...so much fun and it's immediately obvious this guy is one of the smartest people you're ever going to meet.  Highly recommended.  Ease-wise, he was easy in class, but then he just ripped apart my paper.  I agreed with all of his corrections, but it's not really possible to get an A here.

Best professor I have had. He is still very young, but he is incredibly intelligent and makes the content of the class applicable. You can tell he is passionate about English, and although he is a tough grader, you come out a much better writer. He is very easy to talk to, and will help if you need it.

KP is very young, and thus, in touch with his students. He is clearly very smart, and understands the varying interest levels of students. Has some nerdy tendencies, such as an obsession with the end of the world. Really loves what he teaches, but still an inexperienced professor. Fair.
